Breaking changes

SDK contract memberBeforeAfter
model-property-removedConfidentialLedger.LedgerWriteResult preserves its existing language-neutral generated SDK contract.ConfidentialLedger.LedgerWriteResult no longer exposes property transactionId.
model-property-added-requiredConfidentialLedger.LedgerWriteResult preserves its existing language-neutral generated SDK contract.ConfidentialLedger.LedgerWriteResult added required property state.
Why this is breaking: The public LedgerWriteResult model removes transactionId, so existing generated SDK consumers that read that property must migrate to the response wrapper or another location. LedgerWriteResult adds required state to a reachable public model, changing generated constructors and model contracts even though the property is additive on the wire.

modify Add wait-for-commit behavior to ledger entry writes

Replace the preview ledger-entry write shape with a versioned shared-route operation that adds the optional waitForCommit query parameter and returns commit state, receipt, and rollback error information.
